abstract: We prove the strict shifted Dirichlet P\'olya inequality \[ \lambda_k(B_R)>\frac{(d-1)^2\kappa^2}{4}+4\pi^2\left(\frac{k}{\omega_d\operatorname{Vol}_\kappa(B_R)}\right)^{2/d},\qquad k\ge1, \] for every geodesic ball $B_R$ in hyperbolic space of constant sectional curvature $-\kappa^2$, in every dimension $d\ge2$. As a consequence, we obtain the shifted Berezin--Li--Yau type inequality for hyperbolic balls, thereby providing a concrete family of domains satisfying both conjectures proposed by Laptev in 2023. For arbitrary nonempty open subsets $\Omega\subset\mathbb{H}^d_\kappa$ of finite volume, we establish the weak Berezin--Li--Yau type inequality \[ \sum_{j=1}^{m}\lambda_j(\Omega)\ge a_{d,\kappa}m+\frac{d}{d+2}\,4\pi^2\left(\frac{m}{\omega_d\operatorname{Vol}_\kappa(\Omega)}\right)^{2/d}m,\qquad m\ge1, \] with the optimal leading coefficient, where $a_{2,\kappa}=\kappa^2/4$ and $a_{d,\kappa}=d(d-1)\kappa^2/6$ for $d\ge3$. We also establish the global two-sided estimate for the renormalized eigenvalue sum on hyperbolic space, originally proposed by Strichartz in 1996 and valid for $d\ge3$.
hook: Polya's eigenvalue inequality is proved for every ball in hyperbolic space.
summary: The authors prove a shifted Polya bound on Dirichlet eigenvalues for all geodesic balls in hyperbolic space of any dimension. They also prove a weaker Berezin-Li-Yau bound for arbitrary finite-volume open sets. The sharp result covers balls only, so it settles Laptev's conjectures for that family.
title: P\'olya's conjecture for hyperbolic balls and Berezin--Li--Yau type inequalities
